How we work

Good people,
moving quickly,
on things that matter.

Five principles shape how we make decisions, disagree, ship, and treat each other.

Tel Aviv · Studio
01

Ship.

We deliver work quickly and keep things moving forward.

In practice

When something is ready enough to create value, we release it instead of waiting to perfect it.

02

Adapt.

We change direction when reality changes.

In practice

When new information shows a plan is not working, we adjust immediately and move on.

03

Own.

We take responsibility for results, not just tasks.

In practice

When something breaks or stalls, we take it on and stay with it until it is fixed.

04

Evolve.

We keep improving how we work and what we produce.

In practice

After finishing work, we find one thing to do better next time and apply it.

05

Lift.

We actively help others succeed and grow.

In practice

When someone needs help or is stuck, we step in early and support them to get to a good outcome.

Life at Factify.

Come build with us
